name: Dela
text: Dela was a leader of the Fir Bolg. His five sons came from Greece to invade Ireland. They later divided the island into five parts. The dictionary names him in the story of his son Gann. Gann led the invasion and took half of Munster with his brother Sengann. Readers should follow the Fir Bolg entry for the people.

attributes.attribute: a Fir Bolg leader and father of five sons

okr.objective: Record Dela, the Fir Bolg leader whose five sons divided Ireland.
key_results: Dela was a leader of the Fir Bolg.
His five sons came from Greece to invade Ireland.
The sons divided the island into five parts.
One son, Gann, took half of Munster with his brother Sengann.
